title: Spooky Structures
description: This Mod Add a lot of Spoooooky Structures. Great for Horror ModPacks
body:
# Spooky Structures

Spooky Structures expands Minecraft's world generation with a collection of large horror-themed structures to discover and explore. As you travel across your world, you'll encounter eerie locations filled with secrets, custom loot, hidden rooms, and dangerous enemies.

From abandoned hospitals and prisons to haunted churches, graveyards, schools, and even an abandoned amusement park, each structure is designed to make exploration more atmospheric and rewarding.

## Features

* Adds 11 unique horror-themed structures.
* Large, detailed buildings generated naturally throughout the world.
* Custom loot tables with exploration rewards.
* Hidden rooms, treasures, and small environmental stories.
* Designed to enhance survival and adventure gameplay.

## Included Structures

* Hospital
* Prison
* Tower of Terror
* The Egg
* Vampire Castle
* Church
* Graveyard
* School
* Abnormal House
* Factory
* Amusement Park

## Requirements

For the best experience, **Horror Elements** is recommended. Without it, many of the generated structures will appear much emptier than intended.

Whether you're building a horror-themed modpack or simply want more mysterious places to explore, Spooky Structures brings a darker atmosphere and new adventures to every world.
